name: kura-ui
description: Kura UI — agent-first, AI-native React components.

scripts.build: pnpm generate && pnpm --filter @kura-ui/react build && pnpm --filter @kura-ui/mcp --filter @kura-ui/cli build && pnpm --filter @kura-ui/docs build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm generate && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm generate && pnpm validate:meta && pnpm lint && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm test
